description: PHP dependency manager. Runs on OpenMind's portable PHP, never a global one.

features.label: Composer PHAR
features.missingNote: composer.phar isn't in this install. Use Repair to reinstall it.

notes: composer.phar from getcomposer.org (SHA256 from its .sha256sum). The `composer` command is a small launcher that runs the phar with the active OpenMind PHP; without one installed it tells you so.
